_about: Facts about how duties open, restated in our own words from the Console Games Wiki (ffxiv.consolegameswiki.com, checked November 2026; the wiki publishes no licence, so no text is copied). The game data is used first; these fill the gaps. Quest names are looked up in the game data for the giver and place.

Another Aloalo Island.unlock: Clear Aloalo Island and its quest Stranger from Paradise, then talk to Osmon in Old Sharlayan (11.9, 13.3) as a level 90 combat job

Another Merchant's Tale.unlock: Defeat all three bosses of The Merchant's Tale (Advanced), then talk to Osmon in Old Sharlayan (11.9, 13.3)

Another Mount Rokkon.unlock: Clear Mount Rokkon and its quest Mononoke Aware, then talk to Osmon in Old Sharlayan (11.9, 13.3) as a level 90 combat job

Another Sil'dihn Subterrane.unlock: Clear The Sil'dihn Subterrane and its quest A Key to the Past, then talk to Osmon in Old Sharlayan (11.9, 13.3) as a level 90 combat job

Cenote Ja Ja Gural.unlock: No unlock: a portal can open after you open the coffer of a Timeworn Br'aaxskin Map

Dancing Mad (Ultimate).unlock: Clear AAC Heavyweight M4 (Savage), then talk to the Wandering Minstrel in Tuliyollal (11.1, 14.6) as a level 100 combat job
Dancing Mad (Ultimate).note: Raid Finder only, with a pre-made party of eight who have all cleared that savage fight

Dragonsong's Reprise (Ultimate).quest: I Wandered Sharlayan as a Minstrel
Dragonsong's Reprise (Ultimate).note: Raid Finder only, with a pre-made party of eight

Emanation (Extreme).quest: Songs in the Key of Kugane

Eureka Orthos.entrance: Mor Dhona (34.8, 19.2); Burnel by the Revenant's Toll aetheryte (21.8, 8.1) takes you there
Eureka Orthos.note: Needs the Endwalker main story and floor 50 of the Palace of the Dead. Matched parties beyond floor 30 also need the sidequest Rage Extinguished

Futures Rewritten (Ultimate).unlock: Clear AAC Light-heavyweight M4 (Savage), then talk to the Wandering Minstrel in Tuliyollal (11.1, 14.6) as a level 100 combat job
Futures Rewritten (Ultimate).note: Raid Finder only, with a pre-made party of eight who have all cleared that savage fight

Heaven-on-High.note: Needs floor 50 of the Palace of the Dead and the quest Tide Goes in, Imperials Go Out. Matched parties beyond floor 30 also need the sidequest On the Shoulders of Giants

Hells' Kier (Extreme).quest: Songs in the Key of Kugane

Mount Ordeals (Extreme).quest: I Wandered Sharlayan as a Minstrel

Pilgrim's Traverse.note: Needs the Endwalker main story and floor 50 of the Palace of the Dead. After the quest Faerie Tale a new save can start from stone 1, 21, 31, 51 or 71 once you have progressed that far

Storm's Crown (Extreme).quest: I Wandered Sharlayan as a Minstrel

The Abyssal Fracture (Extreme).quest: I Wandered Sharlayan as a Minstrel

The Aquapolis.unlock: No unlock: a portal opens about half the time after you dig up and open the coffer of a Dragonskin treasure map
The Aquapolis.note: You have 10 minutes to enter; whoever used the map opens each room's coffer

The Cloud of Darkness (Chaotic).unlock: Finish the Dawntrail main story, then talk to the Wandering Minstrel
The Cloud of Darkness (Chaotic).note: 24-player chaotic alliance raid; groups usually form in the Party Finder before queueing

The Dungeons of Lyhe Ghiah.unlock: No unlock: a portal can open after you open the coffer of a Timeworn Zonureskin Map; it leads here or to the Shifting Oubliettes at random

The Epic of Alexander (Ultimate).unlock: Clear Eden's Gate: Sepulture (Savage), then talk to the Wandering Minstrel in Kugane (11.6, 12.6) as a level 80 combat job
The Epic of Alexander (Ultimate).note: Raid Finder only, with a pre-made party of eight who have all cleared that savage fight

The Excitatron 6000.unlock: No unlock: a portal can open after you open the coffer of a Timeworn Kumbhiraskin Map

The Final Verse.unlock: Reach stone 99 of Pilgrim's Traverse, then talk to Vanthau in Il Mheg (29.9, 6.0) and choose Invoke the Final Verse
The Final Verse.note: A practice version of the stone 99 boss; your aetherpool from Pilgrim's Traverse applies, and matched parties need aetherpool +94 or more

The Final Verse (Quantum).unlock: Clear stone 100 of Pilgrim's Traverse and finish the quest A Branch and Their Sapling, then talk to Vanthau in Il Mheg (29.9, 6.0)
The Final Verse (Quantum).note: A harder version of the stone 99 boss

The Forked Tower: Magic.quest: In the Shadow of the Tower

The Forked Tower: Magic (Extreme).quest: In the Shadow of the Tower

The Haunted Manor.note: Seasonal: only open while All Saints' Wake runs; no class, job or level requirement

The Hidden Canals of Uznair.unlock: Find a Timeworn Thief's Map in a coffer of the Lost Canals or the Shifting Altars of Uznair, then Dig at the spot it shows to call the portal

The Jade Stoa (Extreme).quest: Songs in the Key of Kugane

The Lost Canals of Uznair.unlock: No unlock: a portal can open after you open the coffer of a Timeworn Gazelleskin Map; it leads here or to the Shifting Altars at random

The Minstrel's Ballad: Endsinger's Aria.quest: I Wandered Sharlayan as a Minstrel

The Minstrel's Ballad: Hydaelyn's Call.quest: I Wandered Sharlayan as a Minstrel

The Minstrel's Ballad: Shinryu's Domain.quest: Songs in the Key of Kugane

The Minstrel's Ballad: Zodiark's Fall.quest: I Wandered Sharlayan as a Minstrel

The Omega Protocol (Ultimate).quest: I Wandered Sharlayan as a Minstrel
The Omega Protocol (Ultimate).note: Raid Finder only, with a pre-made party of eight

The Palace of the Dead.note: Floors 51 to 100 need floor 50 cleared and the quest What Lies Beneath; a new save can start on floor 51 after clearing floor 50 and finishing The Nightmare's End. Clearing floor 50 here is what opens the other deep dungeons

The Phantoms' Feast.note: Seasonal: it ran during All Saints' Wake (2021); no class, job or level requirement

The Pool of Tribute (Extreme).quest: Songs in the Key of Kugane

The Pâtisserie.note: Seasonal: Valentione's Day; enter by talking to a House Valentione Pâtissier at Mih Khetto's Amphitheatre (Old Gridania) or the Acorn Orchard (New Gridania)

The Shifting Altars of Uznair.unlock: No unlock: a portal can open after you open the coffer of a Timeworn Gazelleskin Map; it leads here or to the Lost Canals at random

The Shifting Gymnasion Agonon.unlock: No unlock: a portal sometimes opens after you open the coffer of a Timeworn Ophiotauroskin Map

The Shifting Oubliettes of Lyhe Ghiah.unlock: No unlock: a portal can open after you open the coffer of a Timeworn Zonureskin Map; it leads here or to the Dungeons of Lyhe Ghiah at random

The Unending Coil of Bahamut (Ultimate).unlock: Clear Deltascape V4.0 (Savage), then talk to the Wandering Minstrel in Kugane (11.6, 12.6) as a level 70 combat job
The Unending Coil of Bahamut (Ultimate).note: Raid Finder only, with a pre-made party of eight who have all cleared that savage fight

The Valentione's Ceremony.note: Seasonal: it ran during Valentione's Day (2018 to 2020 and 2023); no class, job or level requirement

The Voidcast Dais (Extreme).quest: I Wandered Sharlayan as a Minstrel

The Weapon's Refrain (Ultimate).unlock: Clear Sigmascape V4.0 (Savage), then talk to the Wandering Minstrel in Kugane (11.6, 12.6) as a level 70 combat job
The Weapon's Refrain (Ultimate).note: Raid Finder only, with a pre-made party of eight who have all cleared that savage fight

Urth's Fount.quest: Fear and Odin in the Shroud

Vault Oneiron.unlock: No unlock: a portal can open after you open the coffer of a Timeworn Gargantuaskin Map (only those maps lead here)

rules.crystalline: Crystalline Conflict: unlocked by the Grand Company quest A Pup No Longer (level 30); The Crystal (Line's) Call then explains the rules. Only one arena is in rotation at a time and it changes every 60 minutes
rules.custom: Custom match on this Crystalline Conflict arena: set up a private match with your own players from the Duty Finder (needs Crystalline Conflict unlocked)
rules.frontline: Frontline: unlocked by the quest Like Civilized Men and Women from your Grand Company (level 30, with a job soul crystal equipped). The map in play rotates with the daily Frontline challenge
rules.rivalwings: Rival Wings: unlocked by the quest Earning Your Wings from Softknox at Wolves' Den Pier (5.7, 5.5). With 48 players queues are long outside bonus events
rules.guildhest: Guildhests open after your first guildleve and the quest Simply the Hest in your starting city-state's region; each one then appears at its level
rules.floors: Reach these floors by continuing a save file: each set of ten opens once the set before it has been cleared in that save
